svg.title: Selected mixed screening cells
svg.desc: Three selected source-ordered screening cells: Abstrackr, Covidence, and EPPI-Reviewer Prioritised Screening. Each has Acceptable for use and Requires validation within the review recommendations for different workflows. These cells do not establish that a product supplies a validated stopping procedure.
